Grandma Harriet — our rock 🌸

✦ A Life Full of Love ✦
✦   ✦   ✦

Dear Grandma Harriet,

You are the rock that has kept this family together — the one constant, the steady hand, the warm heart that every single one of us has leaned on at one point or another. And somehow, you make it all look effortless.

You are the most caring person I know. Always putting others first, never keeping score, and never once making anyone feel like a burden. That is a rare and beautiful gift.

Let’s talk about the food for a second. Your chicken cordon bleu and tortellini with cream sauce? There is no restaurant, no chef, no five-star anything that comes close. Every time you cook, you’re not just feeding us — you’re loving us. And the leftovers? Those might honestly be the best part. We never leave your house hungry, and we never leave empty-handed. That’s just who you are.

Annabelle and Charlotte are two of the luckiest girls alive to have you as their grandmother. You spoil them rotten (in the best possible way), you never miss a dance recital, a school play, a T-ball game, or a lacrosse match. You show up. Every. Single. Time. That means more than you will ever know.

❈   ❈   ❈

The holidays? Nobody does it like you. You go completely over the top, you stress yourself out, you turn the whole house into an event — and somewhere in the middle of the chaos you’re somehow also making sure everyone has enough to eat, enough to open, and enough memories to last a lifetime. We wouldn’t have it any other way. (Even if we do have to talk you off the ledge around December 23rd every year. 😂)

And yes — you love your politics. You’re passionate, you’re opinionated, and you’re occasionally a little nutty about it — but it all comes from the same place everything else does: a good heart that just wants the best for everyone.

I would not be the man I am today — with my beautiful family, my beautiful girls, and everything I have — if not for you and all you have sacrificed over the years. You built the foundation. We are all living on it.

We love you more than words can say. Happy Mother’s Day, Grandma Harriet.

With all our love,

Russell, Roe, Annabelle & Charlotte 🌸
